verdict.rationale: HubSpot's public APIs let you retrieve contacts, custom objects, and account details (GET endpoints, OpenAPI specs), which technically enables pulling your data out programmatically, but the evidence pack contains no dedicated 'export all your data' feature, no CSV/JSON bulk-export documentation, and only import (not export) tooling is described in the knowledge base. Missing for 10: an official bulk data-export tool/guide, confirmation of open-format exports (CSV/JSON) for full account data, and any documentation addressing account closure/data portability guarantees.
